scope: Synthetic pilot-assisted bosonic displacement recovery; no hardware, protecting QEC code, or theory validation
candidate: predictive-likelihood mixture of EW Gaussian experts; conventional adaptive empirical Bayes, not a SEFI derivation
selection: Select best EW and best rolling baseline by equally weighted mean development fidelity across all scenarios; select stronger family for primary comparator. No evaluation tuning.
primary_inference: Paired seed-cluster percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, 95% CI on candidate minus selected conventional baseline in joint_drift. Improvement supported only if lower bound > 0. No universal-superiority claim.
secondary_inference: Per-scenario means and descriptive paired intervals; not confirmatory claims after multiple comparisons
speed: Seven alternating-order repeated complete-stream runs on evaluation seed 2001 joint_drift, including initialization, prediction and update, excluding file IO and simulator. Warm up separately. Median microseconds/sample; no hardware feedback deadline established.
information: All estimators receive the same 512 noisy calibration observations and causal probe means y_t. No truth, future observations, regime labels or change times are supplied. Observation-noise R=I/32 is known.
model: Calibration beta~N(0,diag(0.15^2,0.075^2)). Stream beta_t independent conditional on scripted mean/covariance. y_t=beta_t+epsilon_t with epsilon~N(0,I/32).

scenario_definitions.mean_step: mean changes at 1/3 and 2/3 of stream to (0.45,-0.30) and (-0.25,0.35)
scenario_definitions.rotation: anisotropic covariance angle rotates 0 to 2*pi; major standard deviation 0.15
scenario_definitions.joint_drift: mean=(0.35*sin(4*pi*u),0.25*cos(3*pi*u)-0.25); covariance angle=3*pi*u; major standard deviation=0.10+0.18*(0.5+0.5*sin(2*pi*u)); minor/major=0.5; u=t/(T-1)
scenario_definitions.bursts: stationary distribution plus 5% independent additive N(0,0.7^2 I) burst displacements

interruption: Each run has started/completed/interrupted/failed manifest status; interrupted or failed runs excluded from summaries; final completion requires every prescribed evaluation case.
resources: Local computation only. No paid services. Prior research equations and console unchanged.
